cv.titular: Customer Support Specialist · SaaS for Hospitality

parrafos: I'm writing about the Customer Support Specialist opening for your hospitality POS platform, which I saw on LinkedIn. Six years handling tier 1 and 2 technical incidents for SaaS accounts line up closely with what the role asks for.

At Example Inc. I resolved configuration and connectivity issues by phone and chat for more than 30 SMB accounts, logging every case through ticketing software. I also queried customer data in SQL to set up subscription billing and webhook reconciliation, clearing payment and account-state incidents without pulling in engineering. Automating triage over an LLM API cut first-response time by 50%.

Before that, I ran daily operations at a restaurant for three years: stock, suppliers, payroll and cost control. I rolled out a digital POS system there myself, so I know how these tools work from the floor, not just from the ticket queue.
I'm available to start immediately and can cover rotating shifts, including weekends. I'd like to talk about how I can support your restaurant and bar customers.
